summary: Mono-black Spirit graveyard combo: dump the legend suite with Iname, then Mortal Combat or reanimate the pile.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Mortal Combat after a dumped yard is the primary win.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: The plan is to put the whole Spirit suite in the yard at once.

tags.name: spirits
tags.reason: Iname only mills Spirits; the creature base is a Spirit pile.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Living Death and Bidding are the backup if Combat is not online.

tags.name: self-mill
tags.reason: Iname and helpers fill your yard rather than milling opponents.

tags.name: alternate wincon
tags.reason: Mortal Combat is an explicit alternate win condition.
